followUpTo: ISSUES #140 (rng146 census battle 811: '... GLOOM's action runs its own slot-3 move (MOONLIGHT 236)')
title: C1 on the census-811 side: the FOE's battler dragged in by the player's faster Whirlwind before it acts does not act (no MOONLIGHT, no ROAR)
scenario: Census battle 811's shape (player BEAUTIFLY's faster WHIRLWIND drags the foe's RHYHORN out before its banked ROAR acts). Player BEAUTIFLY (Whirlwind / Silver Wind / Mega Drain / Attract, Jolly, 255 Speed EVs) picks slot 0 every turn; opponent RHYHORN (Roar x4) and bench GLOOM / VOLBEAT (Moonlight x4 each; census GLOOM's slot 3 was MOONLIGHT 236). The random pick drags in VOLBEAT on turns 1/3/5 and GLOOM (census 811's mon) on turn 7; each time the dragged-in mon takes no action that turn, then uses its own MOONLIGHT on its next turn ('HP is full!').

fixShape: (1) battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.ts, in the :1325-1338 cancel body: for every turn-order slot i with battlerByTurnOrder[i] === battler write actionsByTurnOrder[i] = 12 (B_ACTION_CANCEL_PARTNER; source :5270-5274). No new draw sites; the post-fix sequence is the ROM's.
